Workshops in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 11 events

Hands-on workshops and one-off classes where you make, cook, paint or learn something new. Most need no experience and are a sociable way to spend an afternoon or evening, on your own or with friends. Places are often limited, and the list is refreshed every week. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

    Price

  3. Live Nude Painting Session by Crazyjuuls

    Workshops · Art & Design

    When
    Fri 20 Nov, 17:00–19:00 or 20:00–22:00
    Where
    TG Spaces (Studio M), Zeeburgerpad 22, Amsterdam (Oostelijk Havengebied)
    Price
    €40 incl. materials and one drink
    Organiser
    Crazyjuuls

    A beginner-friendly life-painting class with a professional nude model in Studio M at TG Spaces. Crazyjuuls leads short charcoal and acrylic exercises, then a final painting; materials and one drink are included. Pick the 17:00 or 20:00 session.

  4. Open Avond at Beest Boulders Amsterdam

    Sport · Workshops

    When
    Fri 20 Nov, 18:00–23:00
    Where
    Beest Boulders Amsterdam, Willem de Zwijgerlaan 338B, Amsterdam (West)
    Price
    €5 incl. shoes and a 1-hour workshop; reserve
    Organiser
    Beest Boulders

    A try-out evening for newcomers: after signing in at the bar you join a one-hour workshop on the basics of bouldering, then climb for the rest of the evening. Shoes are included. The same open evening also runs at Het Lab, Transformatorweg 32. Reserve online or at the gym.
